name: tdt-platform
description: TDT Platform: owned channel catalogue, playback-source registry, EPG and versioned API.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @tdt/contracts && npm run build -w @tdt/api-client && npm run build -w @tdt/backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @tdt/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @tdt/api-client && npm run typecheck -w @tdt/backend
scripts.test: npm run test -w @tdt/contracts && npm run test -w @tdt/backend && npm run test -w @tdt/api-client
